# FlowCraft Studio

> FlowCraft Studio is an independent software engineering studio run by Subhan Balbale in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It builds fast mobile websites for local businesses (SiteMaker, available at https://mysitemaker.in), smart automated 5-star Google review collection systems, Google Maps lead generation software (LeadsFlowPro), and website diagnostics (StarScanner). Work is done directly by the founder: no agency, no monthly retainers.

## Quick facts

- Founder and sole engineer: Subhan Balbale
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Contact: +91 93724 07018 (phone and WhatsApp), subhanilyasbalbale@gmail.com
- Availability: online service, reachable 24/7 on WhatsApp
- SiteMaker website: ₹5,999 one time, no monthly hosting fee, live in 24 to 48 hours
- SiteMaker WebApp: https://mysitemaker.in
- Smart Automated Review System: https://flowcraft-studio.netlify.app/reviews.html (automated WhatsApp & QR triggers with 5-star Google review routing and private negative feedback shielding)
- Typical delivery: 24 to 48 hours for websites and review automations
- The client owns the source code and the domain

## Products

- [SiteMaker WebApp](https://mysitemaker.in): Ready-made, high-speed mobile website builder for local trades such as salons, dentists, clinics, cafes, and contractors. Imports photos and reviews from the business's Google Maps listing and adds one-tap WhatsApp inquiry buttons. ₹5,999 once, no monthly hosting fee, live in 24 hours.
- [Smart Automated Review System](https://flowcraft-studio.netlify.app/reviews.html): Automated post-service review workflows via WhatsApp and smart QR triggers. Happy customers (4–5 stars) are routed directly to the business's Google review box with 5 stars pre-selected; unhappy customers (1–3 stars) are routed to a private WhatsApp form so issues can be resolved before public reviews are posted. Automatically synchronizes new Google reviews with SiteMaker websites. Setup is ₹2,999 once, or bundled free with SiteMaker.
- [LeadsFlowPro](https://flowcraft-studio.netlify.app/leadsflowpro.html): B2B lead generation tool that finds businesses on Google Maps with no website, sorts them into a calling pipeline, and launches one-click WhatsApp outreach.
- [StarScanner](https://flowcraft-studio.netlify.app/starscanner.html): Diagnostic scanner that audits a local business website for broken links, missing security headers, Core Web Vitals problems, and search visibility gaps.

## Services

- Local search: Google Business Profile optimization, category and citation cleanup, geotagged photos, aiming at the Google Maps top 3-pack.
- Measurement: Google Search Console verification, sitemap submission, and GA4 event tracking for calls, direction taps, and WhatsApp clicks.
- Answer and AI engine optimization: entity schema, llms.txt, and structured content so ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini can cite the business.
- Custom web development: client portals, internal tools, and automated business workflows.

## Common questions

- Are there monthly hosting fees for a SiteMaker website? No. Hosting is serverless; the client pays ₹5,999 once and owns the code and the domain.
- How does the SiteMaker webapp work? Visit https://mysitemaker.in, search for your business or trade, and preview your live website in seconds before purchase.
- How fast is delivery? Usually 24 to 48 hours once the Google Maps listing and details are confirmed.
- Can a custom domain be used? Yes, any .in, .com, .store, or .co domain, with an SSL certificate included at no extra cost.
- How does the Smart Automated Review System work? It triggers automated WhatsApp invitations or displays counter QR codes after customer interactions. High ratings go directly to Google Maps; low ratings open a private WhatsApp conversation with the business owner. Dedicated page at https://flowcraft-studio.netlify.app/reviews.html.
